reading: Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelensky, expressed frustration with the US, saying it was not putting enough pressure on Russia during negotiations.
He said delays in receiving missiles used to stop other missiles were costing Ukrainian lives.
He also complained that the US was focusing on the Middle East and providing more help there.
Zelensky said it was strange that Donald Trump had posted a picture showing himself embracing Vladimir Putin and describing him as a friend.
The latest negotiations, held with help from a third party in Abu Dhabi, made no clear progress.
The talks were expected to resume in December, according to Zelensky.
He called for support from allies, countries that help Ukraine, and urged the US to put pressure on Russia.
The US says it is neutral, meaning it does not take either side, while seeking a peace agreement that can last.
Zelensky reported a serious shortage of defensive missiles and said the US was delaying deliveries of Patriot air defence systems.
Russian attacks have become more frequent and deadly, and the number of civilians killed has reached its highest level.
Power cuts and attacks on transport networks have raised operating costs so much that some businesses have shut.
Zelensky acknowledged that Ukraine was preparing for a difficult and dangerous winter.

vocabulary.definition: The feeling of being upset because a problem continues or something prevents progress.
Situations in which something happens later than expected or needed.
Discussions in which people try to reach an agreement.
To continue an activity after a pause.
Countries or groups that support and help one another.
Not supporting either side in a disagreement or conflict.
A situation in which there is less of something than people need.
The money needed to keep a business running.

entries.ja: 問題が続いたり、何かに進展を妨げられたりすることで感じるいら立ち。
entries.ko: 문제가 계속되거나 무언가가 진전을 가로막아서 느끼는 답답하고 속상한 감정.
entries.zh-Hans: 因为问题持续存在或某种因素阻碍进展而感到烦躁的情绪。
entries.es: Sensación de malestar porque un problema continúa o algo impide avanzar.
entries.pt-BR: Sentimento de irritação porque um problema continua ou algo impede o progresso.
entries.fr: Sentiment de contrariété parce qu’un problème persiste ou que quelque chose empêche d’avancer.
entries.de: Das Gefühl von Ärger oder Unzufriedenheit, weil ein Problem weiterbesteht oder etwas den Fortschritt verhindert.

entries.ja: 何かが予想されていた時期や必要な時期よりも遅れること。
entries.ko: 어떤 일이 예상되거나 필요한 시점보다 늦게 일어나는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 某件事比预期或需要的时间更晚发生的情况。
entries.es: Situaciones en las que algo ocurre más tarde de lo esperado o de lo necesario.
entries.pt-BR: Situações em que algo acontece mais tarde do que o esperado ou necessário.
entries.fr: Situations dans lesquelles quelque chose se produit plus tard que prévu ou que nécessaire.
entries.de: Situationen, in denen etwas später geschieht als erwartet oder nötig.

entries.ja: 合意に達するために行う話し合い。
entries.ko: 사람들이 합의에 도달하기 위해 나누는 논의.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们为达成协议而进行的讨论。
entries.es: Conversaciones en las que las personas intentan llegar a un acuerdo.
entries.pt-BR: Conversas em que as pessoas tentam chegar a um acordo.
entries.fr: Discussions au cours desquelles des personnes essaient de parvenir à un accord.
entries.de: Gespräche, in denen Menschen versuchen, eine Einigung zu erzielen.

entries.ja: 一時中断していた活動を再び続けること。
entries.zh-Hans: 在暂停后继续某项活动。
entries.es: Continuar una actividad después de una pausa.
entries.pt-BR: Continuar uma atividade depois de uma pausa.
entries.fr: Continuer une activité après une interruption.
entries.de: Eine Tätigkeit nach einer Pause fortsetzen.

entries.ja: 互いに支え合い、助け合う国や集団。
entries.zh-Hans: 相互支持和帮助的国家或团体。
entries.es: Países o grupos que se apoyan y se ayudan mutuamente.
entries.pt-BR: Países ou grupos que apoiam e ajudam uns aos outros.
entries.fr: Pays ou groupes qui se soutiennent et s’entraident.
entries.de: Länder oder Gruppen, die einander unterstützen und helfen.

entries.ja: 意見の対立や紛争で、どちらの側も支持しないこと。
entries.ko: 의견 대립이나 분쟁에서 어느 쪽도 지지하지 않는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 在意见分歧或冲突中不支持任何一方的。
entries.es: Que no apoya a ninguna de las partes en un desacuerdo o conflicto.
entries.pt-BR: Que não apoia nenhum dos lados em uma divergência ou conflito.
entries.fr: Qui ne soutient aucun des deux camps dans un désaccord ou un conflit.
entries.de: Ohne in einer Meinungsverschiedenheit oder einem Konflikt eine der beiden Seiten zu unterstützen.

entries.ja: 必要とされる量に対して、何かが足りない状況。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 사람들에게 필요한 양보다 적게 있는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 某种东西的数量少于人们所需的情况。
entries.es: Situación en la que hay menos de algo de lo que las personas necesitan.
entries.pt-BR: Situação em que há menos de algo do que as pessoas precisam.
entries.fr: Situation dans laquelle la quantité disponible de quelque chose est inférieure aux besoins des personnes.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der von etwas weniger vorhanden ist, als die Menschen benötigen.

entries.ja: 事業を続けていくために必要なお金。
entries.ko: 사업을 계속 운영하는 데 필요한 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 维持企业运转所需的资金。
entries.es: Dinero necesario para mantener un negocio en funcionamiento.
entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro necessário para manter uma empresa funcionando.
entries.fr: Argent nécessaire pour maintenir une entreprise en activité.
entries.de: Das Geld, das benötigt wird, um ein Unternehmen am Laufen zu halten.
